visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is split between a mobile MOBA game (Arena of Valor) screen recording and a webcam feed in the top right. A young man with black hair, glasses, and a grey hoodie is speaking into a large professional microphone. On the game screen, several colorful fantasy characters engage in a team fight with bright purple and blue ability effects. (2) The visual focus remains on the intense gameplay; health bars deplete as characters maneuver. The man in the webcam maintains an focused expression, his mouth moving as he provides commentary. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom center. (3) The game character is suddenly eliminated, accompanied by a bright white visual effect. The video cuts to a zoomed-in shot of the streamer in his room. He leans back in his chair, looking disappointed and speechless, while social media IDs are displayed across the bottom of the screen.
